visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses wearing a black t-shirt sits on a wooden bench inside a bright shop, holding a food skewer. (2) A series of close-up shots show home-cooked Japanese dishes on a white tablecloth, including steamed clams in a blue bowl, grilled chicken wings, a whole grilled fish, and bowls of seasoned rice. (3) A toddler boy in a navy blue shirt with a banana pattern sits at a small white table, eating noodles with a fork and later touching pieces of food on his plate. An Anpanman toy and a plush brown dog are on the table next to him. (4) The man and toddler are in a hotel lobby near elevators. The toddler sits in a colorful Anpanman-themed toy cart while the man crouches beside him, pointing toward the camera. (5) Shots of Hiroshima-themed coffee drip bags are followed by the man sitting on a light gray sofa in a modern, well-lit hotel lobby. He waves to the camera. Later, he is seen outdoors feeding a deer in a park area with stone lanterns. (6) A technical sequence displays the hotel signage 'HOTEL GRANVIA HIROSHIMA SOUTH GATE' and a green and white streetcar at a station. The man is then shown in a shop looking at bags of lemon-flavored chips. (7) Detailed shots of a luxury breakfast buffet reveal pastries, various nuts and dried fruits, wagyu sukiyaki, ramen, and eel rice in small boxes. The man is seen eating in the restaurant, giving a thumbs-up gesture while holding chopsticks. (8) The final sequence includes family photos, the man and toddler playing in a blue and white ball pit, the man walking outdoors with the toddler near sunflowers, and a woman waving from a boat. The video ends with the toddler playing with colorful magnetic blocks on a marble-topped table.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel vlog and hotel recommendation targeting families. It shares the personal experience of the creator visiting family in Hiroshima and deciding to stay at a hotel to reduce the burden on their hosts. The second half highlights the 'HOTEL GRANVIA HIROSHIMA SOUTH GATE', specifically its convenient location and impressive breakfast buffet, to encourage viewers to consider the hotel for their own trips.
